This '''battle''' was fought between [[Xim's empire]] and the [[Hutt Empire]] in the [[Xim Wars]], at the Hutt-controlled [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Sleheyron/Legends|Sleheyron]]. Although Xim deeply desired to take Sleheyron with the goal of making it his Ninth Throneworld, the Hutts successfully defended the planet, pushing Xim's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] back to [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], which was known as Xo's Eye at the time.
